scope: Explicit instance tricks on archived inputs only
hypothesis: Traffic layout interacts with softened RANDOM-03 edge costs and RANDOM-04 active-task admission; neither interaction has had an alternative-layout comparison.
selection_rule: Archive every full run and failure. Independently replay any strict-valid best, then exact-repeat and compare paired planner seeds before claiming replication. No held-out input participates.
caveat: These layouts were previously tested under different profiles. This is a bounded interaction test, not a claim that earlier negatives were wrong or a general improvement.
